facts.statement: Yizhousaurus is the most complete basal sauropod dinosaur known to science that possesses an intact skull.
facts.quote: Identified from a nearly complete and exquisitely preserved skeleton, it is the most complete basal sauropod currently known with intact skull.

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton of Yizhousaurus was discovered in 2002 and excavated between October 20 and November 23.
facts.quote: The holotype was discovered in 2002 and was excavated between October 20 through November 23.

facts.statement: Although the name was mentioned in a 2010 abstract, Yizhousaurus was not validly named and described until 2018.
facts.quote: Aunque su nombre fue dado a conocer en un resumen de 2010 de la Geological Society of America realizado por Sankar Chatterjee, T. Wang, S.G. Pan, Z. Dong, X.C. Wu y Paul Upchurch, no contó con una descripción y denominación que fuera válida hasta 2018.

facts.statement: Yizhousaurus lived during the Lower Jurassic period in the Lufeng Formation of Yunnan Province, southern China.
facts.quote: Yizhousaurus (meaning "Yizhou lizard", after the Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Region) is a genus of basal sauropodiform dinosaurs which existed in what is now Lufeng Formation, Yunnan Province of southern China during the lower Jurassic period.

facts.statement: Yizhousaurus is classified as a sauropod dinosaur within the Saurischia order.
facts.quote: superordo: Dinosauria ordo: Saurischia subordo: Sauropodomorpha infraordo: Sauropoda

facts.statement: Yizhousaurus lived between 199.5 and 192.9 million years ago during the Sinemurian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Sinemurian to Sinemurian (199.5 to 192.9 million years ago)

facts.statement: The name Yizhousaurus means "Yizhou lizard" and refers to the Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Region.
facts.quote: Yizhousaurus (meaning "Yizhou lizard", after the Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Region)

rejected.statement: The holotype includes a near-complete skull and lower jaw, 31 vertebrae, shoulder and pelvic girdles, most of both forelimbs, and both thighs.
rejected.quote: It consists of a near-complete skull and lower jaw, 31 vertebrae (nine cervical, fourteen dorsal, three sacral and five caudal), shoulder and pelvic girdles, most of both forelimbs and both thighs.
